title: Air Pollution Complaint
description: Use this service request to report outdoor air pollution, including but not limited to emissions of smoke, dust, gas, fumes, offensive odors, burning emissions, spray painting emissions, and sand blasting emissions. Do not use this request for indoor pollution (smells inside a residence/business), mold, or asbestos. NOTE: Natural Gas odors - please contact Atmos Energy at 1-888-286-6700 or call 911. If odor is coming from the sewer, please contact Dallas Water Utilities by calling 311. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 5 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to report outdoor air pollution.
actions.why: To report outdoor air pollution such as odor, dust, smoke, outdoor burning, or another regulatory concern, including gas or fumes, spray-painting emissions, and sand-blasting emissions. The 311 request form asks when the incident occurred, how long and how often it occurred (once, daily, weekly, or monthly), the weather, the alleged source, and effects on health, property, finances, or the environment, including no alleged effects.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Air Pollution Complaint" requests is not to be used for indoor pollution, smells inside a residence or business, mold, or asbestos. If an odor is coming from the sewer, then contact Dallas Water Utilities by calling 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online. If you smell natural gas, then contact Atmos Energy or emergency dispatch.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Environmental Quality Concerns" > Choose "Air Pollution Complaint"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Environmental Quality Concerns" > Choose "Air Pollution Complaint"

actions.tagline: Call Atmos Energy about a natural gas odor.
actions.why: For a natural gas odor. The description for "Air Pollution Complaint" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs natural gas odors to Atmos Energy instead of treating them as ordinary outdoor odor, dust, smoke, or burning complaints.
actions.why_not: Calling Atmos Energy is not the route for an odor coming from the sewer. If the odor comes from the sewer, then contact Dallas Water Utilities by calling 311 by phone.

actions.tagline: Call 911 for an emergency involving a natural gas odor.
actions.why: For a natural gas odor that needs emergency dispatch; the description for "Air Pollution Complaint" requests on the Dallas 311 website offers 911 as an alternative to contacting Atmos Energy.

actions.tagline: Contact Dallas Water Utilities about a sewer odor.
actions.why: If the odor is coming from the sewer rather than from an outdoor air-pollution source. The description for "Air Pollution Complaint" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs sewer-odor concerns to Dallas Water Utilities by calling 311.
